lines.text: Humans in this world are under threat by robotic weapons called Raptures?
Perhaps we share a common goal.
I'm always ready for battle. Count me in if you need me.
There are so many amazing buildings here.
These machines passing by are called... Nikkes?
I appreciate you allowing me to look around this place.
Where exactly is this supposed to be used?
I will accept your gift, although I do not understand why you give it.
It seems I do not need to be too wary of you.
I will be joining your squad temporarily.
You can't hold a candle to me.
I'll leave the rest to you.
How many of those Raptures are there in total?
So this so-called Ark is mankind's last line of defense?
Nikkes and androids share some similarities.

Let me know if you need me.
I'm ready for anything.
As long as you perform regular cleaning and maintenance, bathing is unnecessary.
Are you the only male here?
What is the function of this?
We don't get to choose our assignments.
Enemy units detected. Wipe them out.
